e.title: Creance：针对「职业被替代」的参数化保障——以劳动力统计指数触发，由 Displacement Bond Notes 出资
e.title_en: Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement, triggered by a labour-statistics index and funded by Displacement Bond Notes
e.title_hk: Creance：針對「職業被替代」的參數化保障——以勞動力統計指數觸發，由 Displacement Bond Notes 出資
e.summary: 面向劳动者的一种参数化保障设计：劳动者按月购买「职业被替代」保障，投资者通过购买 Displacement Bond Notes 为赔付提供资金并以保费作为票息；由官方劳动力统计计算出的公开职业指数决定何时开赔，而一笔索赔还须满足个人层面的额外举证；项目同时在 Hedera 测试网上运行指数预言机、Steward 智能体、Adjuster 与复核队列
e.summary_hk: 面向勞動者的一種參數化保障設計：勞動者按月購買「職業被替代」保障，投資者通過購買 Displacement Bond Notes 為賠付提供資金並以保費作為票息；由官方勞動力統計計算出的公開職業指數決定何時開賠，而一筆索賠還須滿足個人層面的額外舉證；項目同時在 Hedera 測試網上運行指數預言機、Steward 智能體、Adjuster 與複核隊列
e.summary_en: A parametric cover design for workers: workers buy monthly cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons; a public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open, and a claim must also satisfy an additional individual condition; the project also runs an index oracle, a Steward agent, an Adjuster and a review queue on Hedera testnet
e.body:
**Creance** 是一个**面向劳动者的「职业被替代」参数化保障项目**（仓库 `resistingdestiny/creance`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 TypeScript、仓库体量 4,326 KB、创建于 2026-09-04、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**该仓库实测无 topics**；**README 实测 56,743 字节**；**其仓库描述逐字为「Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement. ETHOnline 2026.」**——**即该项目出自 **ETHOnline 2026** 黑客松**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把一条链走完整」**中的**第四种：从产品设计角度走完**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，56,743 字节**）：⭐⭐⭐ **README 开篇逐字，是本条目最有价值的一段**：**「Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying **Displacement Bond Notes** that earn the premiums as coupons. A **public occupation index computed from official labour statistics** decides when claims open, and **a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the** [something]」**——**即「劳动者按月购买针对**其职业被替代**的参数化保障；**投资者通过购买 **Displacement Bond Notes** 为赔付提供资金，并以保费作为票息**；**一个由**官方劳动力统计**计算出的**公开职业指数**决定何时开赔；**而一笔索赔只有在索赔人**还能证明……**时才会赔付」**（**引文在本次读取处截断，词条内即止**）。⭐⭐⭐ **其状态段逐字实测，也是本条目在诚实度上最值得引用的一处**：**其已上线于 **Hedera testnet（测试网）**的部分逐字包括：**note series（票据系列）、coupon and maturity runs（票息与到期安排）、**the index model（指数模型）、the API、worker and investor screens（劳动者与投资者界面）、**the index oracle（指数预言机）**、**the Steward agent**、**the Adjuster**、claim flow（索赔流程）与 **the review queue（复核队列）****；**其 API 的**三个计量端点以 x402 门控、并通过 Blocky402 结算****；**claims topic 上已有**一笔赔付与一笔拒赔**；**并已构建公开部署所需的镜像与 compose 文件**；⭐⭐⭐ **而该段以两句极为直白的局限说明收尾，逐字为**：**「The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. **The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in.**」**——**即「演示数据是预置的、拍摄清单也已写好。**调度器目前只是打印它将要做的事，而不是真的去做；后续工单会把它补上。」****（**作者主动声明一个**尚未实现**的组件****）。**章节结构逐字实测**：**Status／Requirements／Setup／Fifteen minutes from a clean clone／Commands／Which replay windows run／Replaying against the shared testnet resources／Layout／**Payment flow**／**The Steward agent**／Tokenization／**Claims**／⭐ **One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that**／The screens a person claims through／⭐ **Seeing a cover without buying one**／（其余章节本次未读到标题）**；**环境要求逐字实测**为 **Node 22 或更高版本**、**pnpm 11.25.0（由 `package.json` 的 `packageManager` 字段锁定）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「以职业被替代为标的的参数化保障」是本条目最有价值的一点，也是本会话见到的最不寻常的险种设计**——**本站已收录的参数化保险多为**自然灾害**（巨灾债券、地震、飓风、作物天气指数、洪水）**，**而「一个人的职业被自动化/技术替代」是一个**与自然风险机制完全不同的标的****；**其关键设计难题也随之不同：**自然灾种有客观的地理与气象测量，而「职业被替代」是一个**统计上可定义但个体上难以判定**的概念****——**观察其解法正因此有价值**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该险种在精算、法律或商业上可行**——**本次未读其白皮书与模型**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「公开职业指数决定何时开赔 ＋ 索赔人还须额外举证」这一**双条件**设计值得单独记一笔**——**它同时是**参数化（指数触发）**与**补偿型（个体举证）**两种机制的叠加**；**纯粹的参数化保险最大的弱点是**基差风险**（指数触发了个体却没损失，或反之）**；**加一道个体条件正是**压缩基差风险**的做法**（**可与第 320 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「2-source trigger」、第 325 轮 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 的「两条独立位置通道」并读——**三者都在处理**触发依据的可信度与个体化****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该双条件设计确实降低了基差风险**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Displacement Bond Notes：投资者出资、以保费作为票息」是本条目的资金侧设计，也是最接近**巨灾债券**的结构**——**把保费流证券化以吸引资本承担风险**，**与池内 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]] 所代表的巨灾债券逻辑同源**，**只是标的从自然灾害换成了**劳动力市场****；**对做风险证券化或替代性风险转移的学生，这是一个**跨标的迁移的样本**（**⚠️ 本次未读其白皮书第 4 节以外的内容；README 提到其白皮书第 4 节涉及此结构**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in」是本会话见到的最直白的一处**未实现声明****——**多数项目会把未完成的部分**略去不提**，**或写得像已完成**；**而这里作者**明确写出某个组件目前只是打印计划、尚未真正执行，并指出后续工单会补上****；**这与第 327 轮 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的两处 **(honest)** 标题、第 322 轮 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「线上跑的是加固前那一代」构成一条清晰线索：**把「还没做」写在明面上****（**⚠️ 但**本词条**不主张**其他未声明的部分都已实现**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that（一人一赔，以及我们的设定为此付出的代价）」这一节标题值得单独记一笔**——**它对**唯一性约束**（防止同一人重复索赔）做了代价说明**；**在无中心化身份体系的去中心化架构里，「一人一赔」是一个**硬问题****（**⚠️ 本次未读该节，故不转述其身份方案与代价**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「Seeing a cover without buying one（不购买也能看到保障）」单设一节**——**即它提供了一个**试用/预览**路径**；**对缩短用户理解成本是有用的设计**（**⚠️ 本次未读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 技术栈与链上组件逐字实测为：Hedera 测试网、指数预言机、Steward 智能体、Adjuster、复核队列、x402 门控的三个计量端点、Blocky402 结算**——**其中「复核队列」与「Adjuster」说明**自动化之外仍有人工环节****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该复核环节在实际上不可绕过**——**本次未读其实现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「x402 计量端点」值得注意**——**即调用其 API 需按次付费**；**对做 AI/API 经济的学生，这是一个**把计价嵌入协议层**的实例**（**⚠️ 本次未调用其 API**）。**⑨ ⭐ 本项目出自 **ETHOnline 2026 黑客松****，**且自述已有多项组件在**测试网**上线**——**即其成熟度介于「概念」与「原型」之间**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其已达可用产品状态**）。**⑩ ⭐ 可与池内参数化保险与链上风险共担条目并读**：[[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[aratea]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库描述全文与 README（56,743 字节）的开篇、状态段（含已上线组件清单与两处局限说明）、章节结构前若干项、以及环境要求**，⭐ **但**未读 README 多数章节正文（含 Payment flow、The Steward agent、Tokenization、Claims、One person one claim、The screens 等）、未读其白皮书、未克隆、未运行、未访问 Hedera 测试网上的任何资产或记录、未调用其 API、未打开其部署****，因此**不能转述其指数构造、开赔与赔付的完整判定规则、Steward 与 Adjuster 的职权、身份唯一性方案、票据的条款与定价、任何运行数据或部署状态**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其开篇第二句被截断处的完整条件**——**即「索赔人还须证明什么」本次**只读到「…can also show the」为止****；**本词条**不主张**该条件的完整内容**（**这是本条目最需要后续补读的一处**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**该产品在精算、法律与监管上的可行性**——**「职业被替代」作为保险标的是否可保、该结构是否构成保险、以及其在任何辖区是否合规，本次一概未评估**；**本词条**不主张**其合规或可行**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「公开职业指数」所使用的劳动力统计的来源、可得性与更新机制**（**README 只说「官方劳动力统计」，**本次未核实具体来源**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实** Displacement Bond Notes 的条款、定价与投资者保护安排**（**⚠️ 涉及证券发行的合规问题；**本词条不作任何合规判断**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「已上线组件」清单为**其自述****——**本次未访问 Hedera 测试网核对任何资产或记录**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实**其「索引预言机」的数据来源与操纵风险**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ 涉及**劳动者个人数据与职业信息**——**其收集范围、同意方式与合规状态本次未评估**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、黑客松项目、多项组件在测试网**，**不主张其成熟度、可用性或已被采用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/resistingdestiny/creance` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 56,743 字节，开篇、状态段、章节结构与环境要求逐字核对）；**未读白皮书、未克隆、未运行、未访问 Hedera 测试网、未调用其 API**。
e.body_hk:
**Creance** 是一個**面向勞動者的「職業被替代」參數化保障項目**（倉庫 `resistingdestiny/creance`），**MIT 許可，實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 TypeScript、體量 4,326 KB、創建於 2026-09-04、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**該倉庫實測無 topics**；**README 實測 56,743 位元組**；**倉庫描述逐字為「Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement. ETHOnline 2026.」**——**即該項目出自 **ETHOnline 2026** 黑客松**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把一條鏈走完整」**中的**第四種：從產品設計角度走完**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，56,743 位元組**）：⭐⭐⭐ **README 開篇逐字，是本條目最有價值的一段**：**「Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying **Displacement Bond Notes** that earn the premiums as coupons. A **public occupation index computed from official labour statistics** decides when claims open, and **a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the**…」**——**即勞動者按月購買針對**其職業被替代**的參數化保障；**投資者通過購買 Displacement Bond Notes 為賠付提供資金，並以保費作為票息**；**一個由**官方勞動力統計**計算出的**公開職業指數**決定何時開賠**；**而一筆索賠只有在索賠人**還能證明……**時才會賠付**（**引文在本次讀取處截斷，詞條內即止**）。⭐⭐⭐ **狀態段逐字，也是本條目在誠實度上最值得引用的一處**：**已上線於 **Hedera testnet** 的部分逐字包括 note series、coupon and maturity runs、the index model、the API、worker and investor screens、**the index oracle**、**the Steward agent**、**the Adjuster**、claim flow 與 **the review queue****；**其 API 的**三個計量端點以 x402 門控、並通過 Blocky402 結算****；**claims topic 上已有一筆賠付與一筆拒賠**；**並已構建公開部署所需的鏡像與 compose 檔案**；⭐⭐⭐ **該段以兩句極為直白的局限說明收尾，逐字為**：**「The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. **The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in.**」**——**即「**調度器目前只是打印它將要做的事，而不是真的去做；後續工單會把它補上。」****。**章節結構逐字實測**含 **Payment flow／The Steward agent／Tokenization／Claims／⭐One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that／The screens a person claims through／⭐Seeing a cover without buying one**；**環境要求逐字**為 **Node 22 或更高版本**、**pnpm 11.25.0（由 package.json 的 packageManager 欄位鎖定）**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「以職業被替代為標的的參數化保障」是本條目最有價值的一點，也是本會話見到最不尋常的險種設計**——**本站既有的參數化保險多為**自然災害**（巨災債券、地震、颶風、作物天氣指數、洪水）**，**而「一個人的職業被自動化/技術替代」是一個**與自然風險機制完全不同的標的****；**其關鍵難題也隨之不同：**自然災種有客觀的地理與氣象測量，而「職業被替代」是一個**統計上可定義但個體上難以判定**的概念****（**⚠️ 不主張**該險種在精算、法律或商業上可行**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「公開職業指數決定何時開賠 ＋ 索賠人還須額外舉證」這一**雙條件**設計值得單獨記**——**它同時是**參數化（指數觸發）**與**補償型（個體舉證）**兩種機制的疊加**；**純粹參數化保險最大的弱點是**基差風險****，**加一道個體條件正是**壓縮基差風險**的做法**（可與第 320 輪 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的 2-source trigger、第 325 輪 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 的兩條獨立位置通道並讀——**三者都在處理**觸發依據的可信度與個體化****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Displacement Bond Notes：投資者出資、以保費作為票息」是最接近**巨災債券**的資金側結構**——**把保費流證券化以吸引資本承擔風險**，**與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricer]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[artemis]]、[[perils-ied]] 的巨災債券邏輯同源**，**只是標的從自然災害換成了**勞動力市場****。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it」是本會話見到最直白的一處**未實現聲明****（與第 327 輪 [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] 的兩處 (honest) 標題、第 322 輪 [[condition-parametric-zk]] 的「線上跑的是加固前那一代」構成同一線索：**把「還沒做」寫在明面上****；**⚠️ 但不主張**其他未聲明的部分都已實現**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ 「One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that」對**唯一性約束**做了代價說明**（**⚠️ 未讀該節**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「Seeing a cover without buying one」單設一節**（**⚠️ 未讀**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 鏈上組件逐字**：**Hedera 測試網、指數預言機、Steward 智能體、Adjuster、複核隊列、x402 門控的三個計量端點、Blocky402 結算**——**其中「複核隊列」與「Adjuster」說明**自動化之外仍有人工環節****（**⚠️ 不主張**該複核環節實際上不可繞過**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ 「x402 計量端點」把計價嵌入協議層**（**⚠️ 未調用其 API**）。**⑨ ⭐ ETHOnline 2026 黑客松項目、多項組件在測試網**——**成熟度介於「概念」與「原型」之間**。**⑩ ⭐ 可與 [[aegis-parametric]]、[[parametric-insurance-demo]]、[[parametric-risk-toolkit]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[aratea]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、描述全文與 README 的開篇、狀態段（含已上線組件清單與兩處局限說明）、章節結構前若干項與環境要求**，⭐ **但**未讀多數章節正文（含 Payment flow／The Steward agent／Tokenization／Claims／One person one claim／The screens）、未讀白皮書、未克隆、未運行、未訪問 Hedera 測試網上任何資產或記錄、未調用其 API、未打開其部署****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其開篇第二句被截斷處的完整條件**——**即「索賠人還須證明什麼」本次只讀到「…can also show the」為止****，**不主張**該條件的完整內容（**這是本條目最需要後續補讀的一處**）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**該產品在精算、法律與監管上的可行性**——**「職業被替代」是否可保、該結構是否構成保險、以及其在任何轄區是否合規，本次一概未評估**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其「公開職業指數」所用勞動力統計的來源、可得性與更新機制**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實** Displacement Bond Notes 的條款、定價與投資者保護安排**（**涉及證券發行的合規問題，不作任何合規判斷**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ 「已上線組件」清單為其自述**——**未訪問 Hedera 測試網核對任何資產或記錄**；**⑦ ⭐ **未核實**其「索引預言機」的數據來源與操縱風險**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ 涉及**勞動者個人數據與職業資訊****——**其收集範圍、同意方式與合規狀態未評估**；**⑨ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、黑客松項目、多項組件在測試網**，**不主張其成熟度、可用性或已被採用**；**⑩ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/resistingdestiny/creance` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未讀白皮書、未克隆、未運行、未訪問 Hedera 測試網、未調用其 API**。
e.body_en:
**Creance** is **a parametric cover project against occupation displacement** (repository `resistingdestiny/creance`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, TypeScript as the primary language, a 4,326 KB repository, created 2026-09-04 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **the repository measurably has no topics**; **the README measures 56,743 bytes**; **its repository description reads verbatim "Creance: parametric cover against occupation displacement. ETHOnline 2026."** — **so the project comes from the ETHOnline 2026 hackathon**. It is the fourth of this round’s four ways of walking a chain end to end: **completeness through product design**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 56,743-byte README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **the opening, read verbatim, is the entry’s most valuable passage**: **"Workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced, and investors fund the payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons. A public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open, and a claim pays only when the claimant can also show the [something]"** — **workers buy monthly parametric cover against their occupation being displaced; investors fund payouts by buying Displacement Bond Notes that earn the premiums as coupons; a public occupation index computed from official labour statistics decides when claims open; and a claim pays only when the claimant can also show …** (**the quotation truncates at the point read and the entry quotes no further**). ⭐⭐⭐ **Its status section, read verbatim, is also where its honesty is most quotable**: the components **already live on Hedera testnet** measurably include **the note series, the coupon and maturity runs, the index model, the API, the worker and investor screens, the index oracle, the Steward agent, the Adjuster, the claim flow and the review queue**; **the API’s three metered endpoints are gated with x402 and settle through Blocky402**; **one payout and one decline are on the claims topic**; **and the images and compose file for a public deployment are built**; ⭐⭐⭐ **and the passage closes with two unusually forthright statements of limitation, read verbatim**: **"The demonstration is seeded and its shot list is written. The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in."** — **the author states outright that one component currently only prints what it would do, and that a later ticket will implement it**. **Section headings read verbatim**: **Status / Requirements / Setup / Fifteen minutes from a clean clone / Commands / Which replay windows run / Replaying against the shared testnet resources / Layout / Payment flow / The Steward agent / Tokenization / Claims / ⭐ One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that / The screens a person claims through / ⭐ Seeing a cover without buying one**; **its requirements read verbatim** as **Node 22 or later** and **pnpm 11.25.0, pinned by the `packageManager` field in `package.json`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Parametric cover against occupation displacement is the entry’s most valuable point and the most unusual peril design this session has seen** — **the parametric insurance collected here is mostly natural catastrophe (catastrophe bonds, earthquake, hurricane, crop weather indices, flood)**, **whereas "a person’s occupation being displaced" is an underlying with a completely different mechanism from natural risk**; **and its key design difficulty differs accordingly: natural perils have objective geographic and meteorological measurements, whereas "occupation displaced" is statistically definable but hard to determine for an individual** — **which is exactly why observing its solution has value** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim the cover is actuarially, legally or commercially viable — its white paper and model were not read**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A public occupation index deciding when claims open plus an additional individual condition is a two-condition design worth separate note** — **it layers parametric (index-triggered) and indemnity (individual proof) mechanisms**; **the greatest weakness of purely parametric insurance is basis risk (the index triggers without an individual loss, or the reverse)**, **and adding an individual condition is how basis risk is compressed** (**readable with round 320’s "2-source trigger" in [[condition-parametric-zk]] and round 325’s "two independent channels" in [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]: all three address the credibility and individualisation of the trigger evidence**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim the two-condition design actually reduces basis risk**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Displacement Bond Notes, with investors funding payouts and earning premiums as coupons, is the funding-side design and the closest structure here to a catastrophe bond** — **securitising the premium stream to attract capital to bear the risk**, **the same logic as [[cat-bond-pricing]], [[cat-bond-pricer]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]], [[artemis]] and [[perils-ied]]**, **with the underlying changed from natural catastrophe to the labour market**; **a sample of cross-underlying transfer for students of risk securitisation or alternative risk transfer** (**⚠️ nothing beyond the README’s reference to section 4 of its white paper was read**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "The scheduler still prints what it will do instead of doing it, and a later ticket fills it in" is the most forthright statement of non-implementation this session has seen** — **most projects omit unfinished parts or write them as though complete**, **whereas here the author states plainly that a component currently only prints its plan and names the ticket that will implement it**; **together with the two "(honest)" headings of round 327’s [[cloud-itonami-isic-6520]] and round 322’s "the live deployment is the pre-hardening generation" in [[condition-parametric-zk]], it forms a clear line: writing "not done yet" on the face of the work** (**⚠️ but the entry does not claim every undeclared part is implemented**). **⑤ ⭐⭐ "One person, one claim, and what our configuration costs that" deserves separate note** — **it addresses the cost of a uniqueness constraint (preventing duplicate claims by the same person)**; **in a decentralised architecture without a central identity system, "one person, one claim" is a hard problem** (**that section was not read, so its identity scheme and costs are not restated**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ "Seeing a cover without buying one" as its own section** — **a trial or preview path**, **useful for lowering the cost of understanding** (**not read**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ The on-chain components read verbatim** are **Hedera testnet, an index oracle, the Steward agent, the Adjuster, a review queue, three metered endpoints gated by x402 and Blocky402 settlement** — **the review queue and the Adjuster show human steps remain alongside automation** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that review step is genuinely non-bypassable — its implementation was not read**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ x402-metered endpoints embed pricing in the protocol layer** (**its API was not called**). **⑨ ⭐ An ETHOnline 2026 hackathon project with several components on testnet** sits **between concept and prototype** (**the entry does not claim it is a usable product**). **⑩ ⭐ Readable with the corpus’s parametric insurance and on-chain risk-sharing entries**: [[aegis-parametric]], [[parametric-insurance-demo]], [[parametric-risk-toolkit]], [[condition-parametric-zk]], [[aratea]] and [[payout-assurance-standard]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata, the full repository description, and the README’s 56,743 bytes in respect of its opening, status section (including the live-component list and the two limitation statements), the first entries of its section structure, and its requirements**, ⭐ **but did not read most section bodies (including Payment flow, The Steward agent, Tokenization, Claims, One person one claim and The screens), read its white paper, clone, run, visit any asset or record on Hedera testnet, call its API, or open its deployment**, so **its index construction, the full claim-opening and payout rules, the Steward’s and Adjuster’s powers, its identity-uniqueness scheme, the notes’ terms and pricing, any operating data and its deployment state cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ The full condition in the truncated second sentence of its opening was not verified** — **what the claimant must also show was read only as far as "…can also show the"**; **the entry does not claim the condition’s full content** (**this is the single most important item to read next for this entry**); **③ ⭐⭐⭐ The product’s actuarial, legal and regulatory viability was not verified** — **whether occupation displacement is insurable, whether the structure constitutes insurance, and whether it is compliant in any jurisdiction were not assessed at all**; **the entry does not claim it is compliant or viable**; **④ ⭐⭐ The source, availability and update mechanism of the labour statistics behind its "public occupation index" were not verified** (**the README says only "official labour statistics"**); **⑤ ⭐⭐ The terms, pricing and investor-protection arrangements of the Displacement Bond Notes were not verified** (**⚠️ securities-issuance compliance is engaged; the entry makes no compliance judgement**); **⑥ ⭐⭐ The live-component list is its own account** — **no asset or record on Hedera testnet was visited for confirmation**; **⑦ ⭐ The index oracle’s data sources and manipulation risk were not verified**; **⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ It involves workers’ personal and occupational data** — **collection scope, consent and compliance were not assessed**; **⑨ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, a hackathon project with several components on testnet**, **no maturity, usability or adoption is claimed**; **⑩ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/resistingdestiny/creance` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 56,743-byte README with its opening, status section, section structure and requirements checked verbatim); **no white paper read, nothing cloned or run, no Hedera testnet asset or record visited and no API call made**.
